results.title: Strawberry Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is sweet, soft, and full of warmth. You’re gentle with others, kind to yourself, and find joy in the small, sweet moments of life. People feel calm and loved in your presence—you’re the kind of person who makes the world a little sweeter just by being in it.

results.title: Mango Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is bright, sweet, and full of sunshine. You bring warmth and joy to every room, find sweetness in even the ordinary days, and love sharing small pleasures with the people you care about. You’re optimistic, warm, and impossible not to love.

results.title: Blue Raspberry Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is calm, cool, and gently sweet. You’re steady, reliable, and bring a sense of peace to those around you. You take life at your own pace, stay grounded, and find comfort in the quiet moments that others might miss.

results.title: Watermelon Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is bright, bubbly, and full of fun. You’re playful, upbeat, and make every moment a little lighter. You adapt easily to change, find joy in laughter, and bring energy to any situation—you’re the life of the party in the sweetest way.

results.title: Lemon Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is soft, fresh, and gently bright. You’re thoughtful, sincere, and have a quiet positivity that lifts others up. You’re kind without trying, genuine in all you do, and bring a breath of fresh air to everyone you meet.

results.title: Grape Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is calm, deep, and sweetly comforting. You’re a good listener, deeply empathetic, and create safe spaces for others to be themselves. You value connection over chaos and make people feel truly seen and heard.

results.title: Peach Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is warm, sweet, and incredibly nurturing. You care deeply for the people you love, go out of your way to make them feel special, and find joy in taking care of others. You’re the definition of a heart full of sweetness.

results.title: Cherry Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is sweet, bold, and full of personality. You’re unapologetically yourself, have a gentle confidence, and bring a unique sweetness to everything you do. People remember your kind heart and your one-of-a-kind spirit.

results.title: Coconut Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is calm, sweet, and full of peace. You’re laid-back, easygoing, and find joy in simplicity. You don’t rush through life—instead, you savor each moment and help others slow down and appreciate the sweet things too.

results.title: Pineapple Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is bright, sweet, and full of adventure. You’re curious, optimistic, and find sweetness in new experiences. You embrace life with an open heart and encourage others to step outside their comfort zones in the kindest way.

results.title: Mixed Berry Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is a beautiful mix of sweet, calm, and bright. You adapt to any situation with grace, bring different kinds of sweetness to different people, and have a balanced energy that everyone appreciates. You’re versatile and wonderfully unique.

results.title: Lychee Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is soft, unique, and sweetly mysterious. You’re quiet but deeply interesting, have a gentle charm that draws people in, and reveal your sweetness to those who take the time to know you. You’re a rare and precious kind of sweet.

results.title: Orange Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is bright, warm, and sweetly energetic. You’re enthusiastic, positive, and bring a burst of sunshine to even the dullest days. You love life fully, laugh loudly, and make sure everyone around you feels the joy too.

results.title: Blackberry Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is deep, sweet, and full of strength. You’re resilient, kind, and have a quiet power that inspires others. You’ve faced challenges with grace and still choose to be sweet to the world—your strength is truly beautiful.

results.title: Raspberry Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is sweet, vibrant, and full of heart. You’re passionate about the things you love, kind to a fault, and wear your heart on your sleeve in the most beautiful way. You love deeply and make sure people know how much they mean to you.

results.title: Honey Gummy Aura
results.description: Your gummy aura is warm, sweet, and timeless. You’re the kind of person who feels like home—comforting, reliable, and full of genuine sweetness. You don’t chase trends or attention; you just show up as your kind, wonderful self, and that’s more than enough.
